The main takeaway from our work is that

AncSR2 and ancAR1 are the most similar of any two SRs, suggesting that the ancestral steroid receptor (AncSR) was androgen-sensitive and that the progestagen sensitivity of AncSR2 is the result of a few point mutations.

, although the AncSRs are highly divergent from the human SRs, the AncSR-DHT complex is very similar to its human counterpart, suggesting that the AncSRs may be useful as a model to understand the evolution of steroid sensitivity.
AncSR2 and AncAR1 share the same binding site and that DHT binding to AncAR1 does not involve any major conformational changes in AncSR2.
